title: Compact Hom commutes with sequential homotopy colimits
statement: Let C be a triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] with arbitrary coproducts, and let K be a compact object [def-pc-compact-object] of C. For a sequence X_0 \to X_1 \to \cdots and a homotopy colimit X given by the distinguished triangle \bigoplus_n X_n \xrightarrow{1-\mathrm{shift}} \bigoplus_n X_n \to X \to (\bigoplus_n X_n)[1], the canonical map \varinjlim_n Hom_C(K,X_n) \to Hom_C(K,X) is bijective.

proof.text: Put A = \bigoplus_n X_n. By compactness of K, the canonical maps \bigoplus_n Hom_C(K,X_n) \to Hom_C(K,A) and \bigoplus_n Hom_C(K,X_n[1]) \to Hom_C(K,A[1]) are bijective. Under these identifications, applying Hom_C(K,-) to 1-\mathrm{shift}:A\to A gives the map 1-\mathrm{shift} on the direct sum of the Hom groups.

Apply Hom_C(K,-) to the distinguished telescope triangle. Let q:A\to X and r:X\to A[1] be its consecutive maps. By the consecutive-composition clause, (1-\mathrm{shift})[1]\circ r=0. Under Step 1's direct-sum identification, the map induced by (1-\mathrm{shift})[1] on Hom_C(K,A[1]) is injective: if its image is zero, the first component is zero and then successively every component is zero. Thus for any f:K\to X, the composite c=r\circ f has (1-\mathrm{shift})[1]\circ c=0 and hence c=0. Applying clause (ii) of the cited triangle-exactness lemma to the rotated triangle A\to X\to A[1]\to A[1], f therefore factors through q, so Hom_C(K,A)\to Hom_C(K,X) is surjective. Exactness for the original triangle identifies the kernel of Hom_C(K,A)\to Hom_C(K,X) with the image of the map induced by 1-\mathrm{shift}.

The cokernel of 1-\mathrm{shift} on \bigoplus_n Hom_C(K,X_n) is the direct limit \varinjlim_n Hom_C(K,X_n): it is generated by the components, with the relation identifying an element in stage n with its image in stage n+1. Thus the surjection in the preceding step induces a bijection \varinjlim_n Hom_C(K,X_n) \cong Hom_C(K,X), and this is the canonical map in the statement.

lean.statement: theorem compact_hom_hocolim {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [HasZeroObject C] [HasShift C ℤ] [Preadditive C] [∀ n : ℤ, (shiftFunctor C n).Additive] [Pretriangulated C] [IsTriangulated C] [HasCoproducts.{w} C] (K : C) (hK : IsCompactObject K) (X : ℕ ⥤ C) (Y : C) (q : (∐ fun n : ULift.{w} ℕ ↦ X.obj n.down) ⟶ Y) (r : Y ⟶ (∐ fun n : ULift.{w} ℕ ↦ X.obj n.down)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧) (hT : Triangle.mk (𝟙 (∐ fun n : ULift.{w} ℕ ↦ X.obj n.down) - Sigma.desc (fun n : ULift.{w} ℕ ↦ X.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n.down)) ≫ Sigma.ι (fun k : ULift.{w} ℕ ↦ X.obj k.down) ⟨n.down + 1⟩)) q r ∈ distTriang C) : ∃ φ : colimit (X ⋙ coyoneda.obj (op K)) → (K ⟶ Y), (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : K ⟶ X.obj n), φ (colimit.ι (X ⋙ coyoneda.obj (op K)) n f) = f ≫ Sigma.ι (fun k : ULift.{w} ℕ ↦ X.obj k.down) ⟨n⟩ ≫ q) ∧ Function.Bijective φ
